sections.content:
ok. do the check. 

Lets also record (in the programme?) all our learnings for this process. This is a standard sythetic logic process of iterative cross referencing. We should generally be able to follow this process in any domain that is effectively designed. 

The process will also generally keep being refined. We may find that edges are blurry and an assigment may cause a review of other placements. This is natural. It's what dream cycles are for too
